principle: KEEP_ONLY_IRREDUCIBLE_INFORMATION_AND_IRREDUCIBLE_NATIVE_CAPABILITY; SHARE_ONLY_MINIMUM_SUFFICIENT_DISCLOSURE; REPRESENT_VERIFIED_REPRODUCIBLE_STRUCTURE_AS_LAW_PLUS_RESIDUAL; RECOMPUTE_ONLY_THE_IRREDUCIBLE_DELTA; DERIVE, REUSE, MATERIALIZE, CONNECT_OR_RENT_THE_REST

structuralCompressionPolicy.canonicalForm: STRUCTURE = GENERATOR_LAW + PARAMETERS + DOMAIN_BOUNDARIES + RESIDUAL_EXCEPTIONS + VERIFICATION_PROOF

optimizationHints.NEW_MANDATORY_VENDOR_DEPENDENCY: Prefer connector-neutral or hybrid execution; keep canonical identity/history outside the vendor.
optimizationHints.NEW_PERMANENT_KERNEL_MASS: Apply the Pre-scale Gate: merge, derive, connect, or use a smaller primitive before accepting permanent mass.
optimizationHints.FULL_STATE_WHERE_CAUSAL_REPLAY_EXISTS: Store sufficient causes and sparse checkpoints; materialize deterministic state on demand.
optimizationHints.AI_USED_FOR_DETERMINISTIC_REDISCOVERY: Replace repeat AI reasoning with manifest, fingerprint, replay, deterministic query, or cached proof.
optimizationHints.NATIVE_BUILD_BEFORE_CONNECTOR_TEST: Connect and benchmark the external capability before deciding to implement a native equivalent.
optimizationHints.CAPABILITY_WITHOUT_BENCHMARK: Define correctness, utility, latency, storage, compute, energy, cost, portability, privacy, and provenance metrics first.
optimizationHints.UNKNOWN_MISSION_IMPACT: Do not delete the idea; compile it into a smaller proposal whose mission impacts can be measured.
optimizationHints.UNKNOWN_DISCLOSURE_CLASSIFICATION: Classify data as PRIVATE_RAW, LOCAL_CAUSAL, SHAREABLE_DERIVED, or GLOBAL_KNOWLEDGE before any upward transfer.
optimizationHints.REIDENTIFICATION_RISK_UNRESOLVED: Do not assume semantic normalization is anonymity; reduce timing/rarity/precision leakage or require explicit privacy review.
optimizationHints.GLOBAL_KNOWLEDGE_WITHOUT_PROVENANCE: Promote only knowledge that retains allowed evidence/provenance roots and source-independence metadata.
optimizationHints.FULL_CHILD_HISTORY_UPLINK_WHERE_CAPSULE_: Keep child life local; uplink only novel causal knowledge/capsules required by the parent.
optimizationHints.DUPLICATE_DISCOVERY_IN_MOTHER_MEMORY: Consolidate equivalent discoveries into one knowledge object with support counts, effect range, conditions and provenance roots.
optimizationHints.PARENT_RECOMPUTES_CHILD_LOCAL_STATE_WITH: Let the child compute locally; parent should receive the minimum verified result rather than recreating private local state.
optimizationHints.UNKNOWN_STRUCTURAL_RECONSTRUCTION: Keep explicit structure until an exact generator plus residual/exceptions can reproduce it under a declared contract.
optimizationHints.PROCEDURAL_GENERATOR_COVERAGE_OR_COLLISI: Prove coverage, overlap/collision behavior and replay semantics before using the generator for addressing, work partitioning or canonical replacement.
optimizationHints.EXPLICIT_STRUCTURE_WHERE_VERIFIED_GENERA: Consider replacing repeated explicit relations with a verified generator law plus parameters, boundaries, residual exceptions and proof.
optimizationHints.CUSTOM_PROCEDURAL_INDEX_BEFORE_BASELINE_: Benchmark against mature hashing, indexing, compression and partitioning first; mathematical elegance is not an optimization result.
optimizationHints.FULL_WORK_ASSIGNMENT_LIST_WHERE_DETERMIN: Encode reproducible fleet work as a compact deterministic partition/generator when coverage and overlap semantics are proven.
optimizationHints.PERSIST_MATERIALIZED_WORLD_WITHOUT_CAUSA: Keep the compact canonical cause/generator and materialize the larger logical world only for bounded computation, inspection or export.
optimizationHints.INCREMENTAL_DEPENDENCY_SEMANTICS_UNKNOWN: Do not trust delta recomputation until the dependency graph and invalidation boundaries are proven for the result.
optimizationHints.CACHE_IDENTITY_OR_INVALIDATION_UNKNOWN: A cached result is reusable only when all law/state/input/runtime identities and invalidation rules are complete.
optimizationHints.APPROXIMATE_PREFILTER_FALSE_NEGATIVE_SEM: Measure recall and false-negative behavior; use approximation only where missing candidates is explicitly safe or followed by a complete exact path.
optimizationHints.CHANGE_POINT_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK_UNKNOWN: Use change-point detection as a sensor until missed-change behavior is bounded for the information class being compressed.
optimizationHints.MERKLE_PROOF_MISINTERPRETED_AS_SEMANTIC_: Treat Merkle evidence as integrity/membership proof only; semantic truth still requires the domain evidence contract.
optimizationHints.FULL_RECOMPUTE_WHERE_VERIFIED_DELTA_SUFF: Propagate the causal delta through proven dependencies instead of recomputing unaffected world state.
optimizationHints.DUPLICATE_IMMUTABLE_PREFIX_ACROSS_BRANCH: Use content-addressed DAG structural sharing so counterfactual branches store one immutable common prefix plus deltas.
optimizationHints.REPEATED_DETERMINISTIC_COMPUTE_WHERE_CON: Reuse a verified content-addressed result keyed by complete semantic inputs instead of repeating the same deterministic computation.
optimizationHints.FULL_EXACT_SCAN_BEFORE_SAFE_PREFILTER: Use a cheap high-recall sketch/signature/index to reduce candidates, then perform exact verification on the survivors.
optimizationHints.DENSE_BOOLEAN_OR_SET_STORAGE_WHERE_SPARS: Use sparse matrices, compressed bitmaps or succinct exact sets when most possible relations are empty/false.
optimizationHints.FIXED_CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL_WITHOUT_COST_M: Choose checkpoint density from measured storage, replay frequency, latency and recovery cost rather than a blind fixed interval.
optimizationHints.CUSTOM_LOCALITY_OR_SKETCH_METHOD_BEFORE_: Benchmark Hilbert/Morton, LSH/MinHash, sketches or custom locality operators against mature indexes and workload-specific baselines before adoption.
optimizationHints.EXECUTION_PLAN_IGNORES_MEASURED_RESOURCE: After correctness/privacy/provenance constraints, choose among replay, cache, delta, materialization, local compute and connectors using measured total cost.
